hospitalDetails.name: Maternity Place at Broward Health Medical Center
hospitalDetails.address: 1600 S Andrews Ave, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Broward Health Medical Center anchors county maternity care from downtown Fort Lauderdale at 1600 S Andrews Ave. Its Maternity Place program is built around family-centered care: 36 private postpartum suites with full-size beds for support partners, three deluxe Empress Suites, and a 70-bed Level III NICU with all private rooms, one of the largest and most advanced in Florida. The in-house team includes obstetricians, neonatologists, anesthesiologists, perinatologists and certified nurse-midwives around the clock, and certified lactation consultants are on staff with a dedicated lactation line. A free breastfeeding support group meets twice monthly in the Lillian Wells Women's Center, and prenatal classes run through Maternity Place. Volume is high here, so the L&D team moves fast: bring a printed one-page birth plan to triage and hand it over early. The free template covers what their triage teams want to see.
hospitalDetails.shortDescription: Broward Health Medical Center anchors Fort Lauderdale maternity care with private suites, 24/7 OB anesthesia and a Level III NICU.

hospitalDetails.name: Holy Cross Hospital Fort Lauderdale
hospitalDetails.address: 4725 N Federal Hwy, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Holy Cross Hospital sits at 4725 N Federal Highway in Fort Lauderdale's east end, the area's other major maternity destination. It handles routine low-risk births alongside higher-complexity deliveries, with obstetrics, maternity and NICU services under one roof, and Holy Cross Medical Group clinics across the region for prenatal appointments. The hospital is part of Trinity Health, a national Catholic health system, and its maternity program follows the system's family-centered care emphasis, which in practice means support persons are welcomed at check-in and encouraged to stay engaged through labor. The main hospital line is 954-492-5768. Visitor and support-person policies are updated regularly, so confirm the current doula policy when you tour or by phone before labor day, and ask how they handle overnight support persons in postpartum if your partner plans to stay. If your baby needs special care after delivery, the on-site NICU covers most needs without a transfer across town, which is one less logistics problem on delivery day.
hospitalDetails.shortDescription: Holy Cross Hospital on Federal Highway provides family-centered maternity and Level II NICU care in Fort Lauderdale's east end.
